platform: Emulated SGI O2/R10000 (IP32), framed-console disks, IPv4 DHCP on mec0

	capabilities=0x1400<TCP4CSUM_Rx,UDP4CSUM_Rx>
	enabled=0
	ec_capabilities=0x1<VLAN_MTU>
	ec_enabled=0
	address: 08:00:69:12:34:56
	media: Ethernet autoselect (100baseTX full-duplex)
	status: active
	inet6 fe80::a00:69ff:fe12:3456%mec0/64 flags 0 scopeid 0x1
	inet 192.168.0.2/24 broadcast 192.168.0.255 flags 0
